description: Start a job to rig and animate one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Animate (the rig is included): 1 to 5 moves, one named clip each in one file. Price by the number of moves: 1 move 50 Gold, 2 moves 65, 3 moves 75, 4 moves 90, 5 moves 105. First call chargen_quote_3d_animate, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

bone_names.description: Bone naming standard, for the engine the model goes to (default tripo).

file_format.description: File type of the result (default glb). Tripo can return FBX even when glb is asked for.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

in_place.description: Keep the model in place instead of moving forward (default false).

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

moves.description: 1 to 5 moves, one clip each (default walk). Each move adds to the price.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_animate. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

rig_type.description: Body type of the skeleton (default auto).

name: chargen_edit_3d_animate
title: Animate 3D model
